ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row OppVR80] Blocks field edits while Stage = Booking Verification. Per IRM correction: Stage changes are explicitly allowed - only non-Stage field edits are blocked (NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName)) added). Note: cannot fully prevent a Stage change...
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR( ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity') )),
NOT(OR( $Permission.Sales_Operations_Bypass, $Permission.Booking_Verification_Access )),
ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification'),
ISCHANGED(LastModifiedDate),
NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Insufficient permissions. Opportunities in Booking Verification stage cannot be updated. Please contact your regional Sales Operations Business Partner for assistance.
